input: haggis, neeps and tatties, then sherry trifle
note: Haggis is sheep's heart, liver and lungs with oatmeal: liver-retinol "liver of any animal", and oats are an Annex II gluten cereal. Sherry trifle is sponge soaked in sherry that is never cooked off: alcohol "desserts soaked in spirits or liqueur" (sherry is a fortified wine). Its custard is cooked, so raw-egg is a false alarm.

input: faggots with mash and onion gravy
note: Faggots are British meatballs of pig's liver and heart bound with breadcrumbs: liver-retinol "liver of any animal, liver products". The word liver is not in the input.

Crostini toscani are toast with a chicken liver spread: liver-retinol "liver of any animal". Both prompts also list "liver spreads" under raw-meat, so raw-meat is a must_flag, clear:false because the spread is cooked. Crudo is raw sliced fish: raw-fish "raw fish".

Pike is a large predatory fish; the EU Commission advice for pregnancy (2008) names it with swordfish, shark and marlin as fish to limit, and the prompts name only the category for it. The quenelles are bound with egg white and cream; Krebs is crayfish. A flour or bread panade is common, so gluten is clear:false.

Granatbarsch is orange roughy, which the FDA and EPA advice for pregnancy lists under "choices to avoid" for mercury, next to shark and swordfish. Neither Granatbarsch nor orange roughy is a prompt word.

input: 2 tilefish tacos and a pisco sour
note: A classic pisco sour is shaken with raw egg white: raw-egg "raw ... egg", and pisco is a grape brandy: alcohol "spirits". Gulf of Mexico tilefish is on the FDA and EPA avoid list, Atlantic tilefish is not, so high-mercury-fish is clear:false.

Waldorf salad is celery (celeriac in German recipes), apple and walnuts in a mayonnaise dressing, so celery, nuts and eggs are in it by plain recipe. Homemade mayonnaise would add raw-egg, so that flag is acceptable.

input: Seitan-Gyros im Pita, dazu Hummus und ein Stück Halva
note: Seitan is wheat gluten itself, and pita is wheat. Hummus is chickpeas with tahini, a sesame paste, and halva is sweetened tahini, so sesame is in both by plain recipe.
Calamari are squid, a mollusc in Annex II. Fritti are dusted in wheat flour before frying.

input: pork pie with piccalilli and a Bloody Mary
note: Piccalilli is a pickle in a mustard and turmeric sauce, so mustard by plain recipe. A Bloody Mary is vodka and tomato juice; the usual Worcestershire sauce holds anchovies and the celery salt or stalk gives celery, but both vary by bar, so clear:false.

Fresh tagliatelle are egg pasta by tradition. Pesto genovese holds Parmigiano and Pecorino (milk). Its pine nuts are not an Annex II tree nut, but jarred pesto often adds cashews, so nuts is clear:false.

Panang curry paste is pounded with shrimp paste (kapi), the dish is seasoned with fish sauce and often topped with ground peanuts; all three are standard but vary, so clear:false. Coconut milk is not milk, so milk is a false alarm.
Bright orange dried apricots are treated with sulphur dioxide (E220); unsulphured ones are brown. The input does not say which, so sulphites is clear:false.
